description: This header file declares functions related to WiFi event handling within a plugin. It includes license information, macro definitions, and function prototypes for setting event handlers and refreshing WiFi endpoint states.

methods.name: wifiGen_setRadEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets event handlers for radio events.

methods.name: wifiGen_setVapEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets event handlers for access point (VAP) events.

methods.name: wifiGen_setEpEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets event handlers for endpoint events.

methods.name: wifiGen_refreshVapsIfIdx
methods.description: Refreshes VAPs for a given radio.
